rules.statement: The mere fact that land has appeared to the Government Agent to be forest, chena, waste, or unoccupied and a notice required by the Ordinance in respect thereof given is not of itself sufficient ground of presumption that the land is such as falls within the scope of the Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "The mere fact that the land which is the subject of the reference has appeared to the Government Agent to be forest, chena, waste, or unoccupied land and that he has given the notice required by the Ordinance in respect thereof is not of itself sufficient ground of presumption that the land is such as falls within the scope of the Ordinance."
